description: This file implements session management functions for the Mattermost platform, including creating, retrieving, revoking sessions, managing session cache, and handling session expiry.

classes.name: PlatformService
classes.description: Service class providing session management functionalities for the Mattermost platform.

methods.name: CreateSession
methods.description: Creates a new session, saves it, and adds it to cache.

methods.name: GetSessionContext
methods.description: Retrieves a session based on token from the store.

methods.name: GetSessions
methods.description: Retrieves all sessions for a user.

methods.name: GetLRUSessions
methods.description: Retrieves least recently used sessions for a user with limit and offset.

methods.name: AddSessionToCache
methods.description: Adds a session to the cache with expiry.

methods.name: ClearUserSessionCacheLocal
methods.description: Clears cache entries for a specific user's sessions locally.

methods.name: ClearAllUsersSessionCacheLocal
methods.description: Clears all session cache entries locally.

methods.name: ClearUserSessionCache
methods.description: Clears cache for a user's sessions and notifies cluster if applicable.

methods.name: ClearAllUsersSessionCache
methods.description: Clears all session caches and notifies cluster if applicable.

methods.name: GetSession
methods.description: Retrieves a session from cache or store by token.

methods.name: GetSessionByID
methods.description: Retrieves a session by session ID.

methods.name: RevokeSessionsFromAllUsers
methods.description: Revokes all sessions and OAuth tokens for all users.

methods.name: RevokeSessionsForDeviceId
methods.description: Revokes sessions for a specific device ID for a user.

methods.name: RevokeSession
methods.description: Revokes a specific session, including OAuth tokens if applicable.

methods.name: RevokeAccessToken
methods.description: Revokes an access token and associated session.

methods.name: SetSessionExpireInHours
methods.description: Sets session expiry based on hours and configuration.

methods.name: ExtendSessionExpiry
methods.description: Extends session expiry and updates cache.

methods.name: UpdateSessionsIsGuest
methods.description: Updates the isGuest property for all user sessions.

methods.name: RevokeAllSessions
methods.description: Revokes all sessions for a specific user.
